summary: Reviewed the assigned walkthrough against current installer contracts. INSTALLER_SPEC fields in spec.py support the question labels, defaults, and visibility; _preflight in gateway_host_preflight.py supports the host, architecture, disk, and port claims; _open_public_probe and verify_public_route in gateway_health.py support the readiness behavior and Docker-proxy limitation; service.py and installer.py support rerun and bootstrap-link behavior; checkout_release.py supports the published-release condition. The page already marks its 2026-11-03, revision-specific source review as historical and does not claim a release was published. No factual correction was needed. External DNS, proxy, ACME, and S3 behavior remains qualified, and the page states those deployments were not operated during review.
